children: Retail sales in Japan increased 2.7% year-on-year in August 2026, below market expectations for a 3.3% rise and slowing from a downwardly revised 3.7% growth in the previous month.
It was the sixth consecutive month of growth in retail activity, mainly boosted by a 17.7% surge in motor vehicle sales.
Increases were also seen in other retail goods (5.2%), non-store retail (3.0%), department stores (1.3%), and pharmaceuticals and cosmetics (0.3%).
By contrast, sales fell for clothing and personal goods (-6.1%), machinery and equipment (-2.3%), and fuel (-0.6%).
On a monthly basis, retail sales fell 1.2% in August, reversing a downwardly revised 2.1% rise in July.

title: Japan Retail Sales Growth Below Forecasts
